what: A: Continue (migrates the fixture save), walk to the door, E, Share on 127.0.0.1:8803, Create an invite (1 use, 7 days)

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { const s = S.useSessionStore.getState(); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world; if (s.screen === 'play' && w.status === 'ready') break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; return JSON.stringify({ world: w.worldId.slice(0, 12), head: w.now.head.n, link: w.status.link, role: w.status.role }) })()

(async () => { const t0 = Date.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const t = l ? l.innerText : ''; if (/Online/.test(t) && /Invites/.test(t)) return { ms: Date.now() - t0 }; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'timeout' })()

(async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) { const l = document.querySelector('[data-layer=door]'); const m = l && /unmapped:\/\/join\?i=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+&k=[A-Za-z0-9_\-]+/.exec([...l.querySelectorAll('input, textarea')].map(x => x.value).join('\n') + '\n' + l.innerText); if (m) { window.__invite = m[0]; return m[0].length; } await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'no link' })()
